script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.progress_percent, j.progress_message, j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at, j.lease_owner, DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due,
       j.row_version, j.error_code, j.error_message, j.error_details, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_PCguard.data.jobId}}

SELECT st.step_name, st.step_status FROM gd_publish_step st WHERE st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND st.job_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.jobId}}' AND st.step_name REGEXP '^P[0-9]_' AND st.is_deleted = 0
SELECT j.prepared_payload FROM gd_async_job j WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_PCguard.data.jobId}}

data.nodeName: The putaway's is_processing and its latest completion lock
data.name: The putaway's is_processing and its latest completion lock

script.code:
SELECT t.is_processing, t.to_status,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('PWC|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN transfer_order_putaway t ON t.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND t.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AND t.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_PCguard.data.jobId}} AND j.correlation_id REGEXP '^TO\\|[0-9]{1,20}$'
